mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (sender_id, receiver_id, content) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, s.username as sender_username, s.avatar_url as sender_avatar_url, r.username as receiver_username, r.avatar_url as receiver_avatar_url FROM message m LEFT JOIN user s ON m.sender_id = s.id LEFT JOIN user r ON m.receiver_id = r.id WHERE (m.sender_id = #{userId1} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (m.sender_id = #{userId2} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId1}) ORDER BY m.create_time ASC

SELECT m.*, s.username as sender_username, s.avatar_url as sender_avatar_url, r.username as receiver_username, r.avatar_url as receiver_avatar_url FROM message m LEFT JOIN user s ON m.sender_id = s.id LEFT JOIN user r ON m.receiver_id = r.id WHERE m.id IN ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM ( SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, create_time FROM message WHERE sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} ) AS temp GROUP BY CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END ) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND is_read = 0
UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{messageId} AND receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
